pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with soft, diffuse pixel gradients at the edges. Geometry varies from roughly quadrilateral to complex polygons with varied spatial areas, appearing larger on the shoulder and smaller on the upper neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light tan pathways forming a lattice. Junction nodes primarily involve three-way and four-way intersections. Corridor thickness is non-uniform and varies as it traverses between the dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the neck and shoulder line, representing short, stiff hair against the background.
